description: REQ-101's new sumRecentGojoGiftsUsd/recentGojoGiftsUsd term (the FIND-005 resolution) has no lenderId-gating anywhere in its specified signature, EARS text, or acceptance criteria, despite the spec's own prose ACKNOWLEDGING the exact mechanism by which this creates a real misattribution bug. behavioral-spec.md's own Dependencies section states: 'this subtraction only correctly attributes gifts to the SAME lender when that lender is the one whose own colony-status/run.sh invocation writes this file (today, in practice, anicca-a3cdd4, per run.sh's own hardcoded sender identity...)'. But nowhere does REQ-101's EARS clause, its computeLenderAvailableUsd/sumRecentGojoGiftsUsd formula, or verification-architecture.md's PROP-101f gate this subtraction on lenderId at all: sumRecentGojoGiftsUsd(gojoLogRows, nowMs, lookbackHours) takes NO lenderId parameter (confirmed against verification-architecture.md line 15's exact exported signature), and REQ-101's EARS text applies the subtraction to 'a citizen... considered as a potential lender' generically, with acceptance-criteria examples using an unqualified 'a lender' -- never conditioned on WHICH lender. Re-read this session, /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/economy/ubi/run.sh (lines 87-96) hardcodes the gojo sender as anicca-a3cdd4 specifically ('me_bal = bal(telemetry_files["anicca-a3cdd4"])'), and the real state file /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/economy/ubi/state/gojo-log.jsonl's one existing row carries no sender/lender field at all (only recipient/recipient_wallet/surplus_above_reserve_usd/decision/executed) -- confirming the spec's own claim that attribution is purely positional (the file's physical location IS the sender). As literally specified, an implementer following REQ-101's own EARS text and acceptance criteria verbatim would apply sumRecentGojoGiftsUsd's output to EVERY lender evaluation, not just anicca-a3cdd4's own -- meaning a completely unrelated self-funded EVM-wallet citizen (a future spawned child, or any second real lender this colony ever gains) would have ITS OWN available surplus incorrectly reduced by anicca-a3cdd4's own committed gojo gifts, a real, load-bearing arithmetic corruption of REQ-101's money-safety-relevant surplus computation. This is a DIFFERENT and NEW gap from the 'reverse-direction, not-yet-solved limitation' the spec explicitly and honestly discloses (gojo unaware of loans.jsonl) -- this is a FORWARD-direction correctness bug the spec's own words gesture at but never actually close with a conditional rule.

evidence.snippet: recentGojoGiftsUsd is a NEW, ONE-WAY, minimal awareness ... computed by sumRecentGojoGiftsUsd(gojoLogRows, nowMs, lookbackHours = 24) ... Because gojo-log.jsonl's own row shape records no explicit sender/lender identifier ... this subtraction only correctly attributes gifts to the SAME lender when that lender is the one whose own ... run.sh invocation writes this file (today, in practice, anicca-a3cdd4)

crossCheck.note: me_bal = bal(telemetry_files['anicca-a3cdd4']); surplus_above_reserve = round(me_bal - RESERVE, 6) -- the gojo sender identity is a hardcoded literal, not a parameter, confirming the log's rows are attributable to exactly one citizen; verification-architecture.md line 15's sumRecentGojoGiftsUsd(gojoLogRows, nowMs, lookbackHours=24) signature (re-read this session) confirms no lenderId parameter exists anywhere to gate this subtraction by which lender is actually being evaluated.
